name: Hyaku Monogatari ~Honto ni Atta Kowai Hanashi~
original_name: 百物語 ~ほんとにあった怖い話~
source:
Its sub-title translated as True Scary Stories, Hyaku Monogatari is a video game homage to the parlour game Hyaku Monogatari Kaidankai, which was popular during the Edo period (17th - middle of 19th century) in Japan. The game involved gathering at night, lighting a hundred candles and telling horror stories, extinguishing the candles one by one until the room became completely dark.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/hyaku-monogatari-honto-ni-atta-kowai-hanashi]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
《百物语》的副标题意为“真实发生的恐怖故事”。这款游戏向江户时代（17世纪至19世纪中叶）流行的室内游戏“百物语怪谈会”致敬。参加者夜间聚集，点燃一百根蜡烛，轮流讲述恐怖故事；每讲完一个故事便熄灭一根蜡烛，直到房间彻底陷入黑暗。

[摘自[url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/hyaku-monogatari-honto-ni-atta-kowai-hanashi]Moby Games[/url]]
